eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 Artificial Intelligence x Humanities, Education, and Art (AIxHEART)
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society; Institute for Semantic Computing Foundation
eventDetail.scope: Artificial Intelligence x Humanities, Education, and Art (AIxHEART) is an international forum for academia and industries to exchange visions and ideas in the state of the art and practice, as well as to identify the emerging topics and define the synergy between AI and humanities, education, and art in general.  TOPICS OF INTEREST​​ include:  Areas that may be assisted by AI, such as:​ - Language - Literature - Music - Architecture - Performing Arts - Filming - Painting - K12 and Higher Education  ​AI Technologies that may be advanced by humanities, education, and art applications, such as: - Generative AI - Transformer based technology - Agent technology - Semantic computing - Decision making - Machine learning - Security - Knowledge and data engineering - Platform and scalability
